title: Kevin Smith joins this week's #DCStudioShowcase... He shares what he thinks is his masterpiece 👀

author: HBO Max
description:
On Season 2, Episode 4 of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, hosts Frankey and Coy sit down with legendary filmmaker, comic creator, and lifelong DC superfan Kevin Smith for an unforgettable conversation about Bizarro: Year None, Batman, comic books, fandom, and the future of the DC Universe. From revealing how he and Eric Carrasco approached reinventing Bizarro to sharing the comic that made him fall in love with Batman, Kevin delivers the kind of behind-the-scenes insight only a true comics obsessive can.

Frankey and Coy also dive into Kevin's history writing DC characters, his thoughts on Batman, creating Onomatopoeia, comic book culture, and why superheroes helped shape his sense of right and wrong. If you're a fan of DC Studios, the DC Universe, comic books, superhero storytelling, and exclusive creator access, this episode is packed with must-hear moments.
